push.title: W 2-0 vs MidwayMonsters | You: 7.5 (above average MID)
push.body:
Good stuff, BellyTb1. A 7.5 against MidwayMonsters. Not fireworks, but a nice warm campfire.

DID WELL
+ A goal against MidwayMonsters, your 4th straight match scoring. Scoring's a lot like karaoke: confidence is half of it.
+ Man of the Match, your 3rd for us. That's leadership you can't fake.
+ 1 tackle won nudged you up +0.2. Every bit counts.
+ 15 completed passes chipped in +0.2. Pennies make dollars.
+ We beat MidwayMonsters 2-0. Wins taste better when everybody chipped in.

WORK ON
- 1 goal from 3 on target. Pick your spot before the ball arrives, then commit. Changing your mind mid-swing is how shots go wide.
- PhogsToffees had the same finishing trouble. Team up on it: square it when the keeper commits.
- 0.6 under your average. Every player has those. The great ones answer back.
- 3 misplaced passes cost you 0.1. Tidy those and the number climbs.
- 2 missed tackles cost 0.1. Think of it as a pebble in your boot. Shake it out.

Practice this: Timed finishing only when you trust it. A clean shot to the corner beats a mistimed rocket.

Tomorrow's a fresh pitch. Let's go make some divots. - Coach Lasso

players.name: tuxedo_slide

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: Found the back of the net. Never gets old, does it?

weaknesses.detail: Pass accuracy: 29% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 71% or less)
weaknesses.title: Passing accuracy
tips: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.
Scan before the ball gets to you - a quick shoulder check means you already know the pass before you need it.
Open your hips to the field when you receive. Side-on body shape turns a back pass into a forward one.
weaknesses.coach: The passing got a little loose out there.

weaknesses.detail: Passes attempted: 14 (bottom quarter of midfielders is 15 or less)
weaknesses.title: On-ball involvement
tips: Show for it. Move into the passing lane and ask for the ball instead of hiding behind your marker.
Give the passer an angle - diagonal to the ball, not flat in a line where it can't reach you.
Move after you pass. A pass-and-move player is always an option.
weaknesses.coach: We didn't see enough of you on the ball. I want you in the thick of it.

weaknesses.detail: Tackle success: 0% (bottom quarter of midfielders is 18% or less)
weaknesses.title: Tackle timing
tips: Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.
weaknesses.coach: Diving in a bit too eager. Patience in the tackle.

players.headline: Quiet midfielder performance (7.0, below average for the position) - best at goal threat; work on passing accuracy, on-ball involvement.

coach.name: Coach Lasso
coach.opener: tuxedo_slide, a 7.0 is a touch under par for a midfielder. That's alright. Even the best tomatoes have a bruise or two.
coach.closer: Growth isn't a straight line. It's more like a squiggle. We're squiggling in the right direction.

push.body:
tuxedo_slide, a 7.0 is a touch under par for a midfielder. That's alright. Even the best tomatoes have a bruise or two.

DID WELL
+ A goal against MidwayMonsters. Never gets old, and I hope it never does.
+ You & BellyTb1 clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ 1 key pass kicked in +0.1. Small hinges swing big doors.
+ Three points off MidwayMonsters, 2-0. Put 'em in the bank and let 'em earn interest.

WORK ON
- 29% passing (4 of 14, down from your usual 56%). Weight matters as much as direction. Firm along the ground beats soft and loopy.
- Only 14 passes (down from your usual 18). Tell you what: Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.
- Won 0 of 4 tackles. Press to cut the passing lane, not to lunge at the ball carrier from behind.
- Funny thing: PhogsToffees wrestled with passing accuracy too. Two heads, one fix: give each other short options.
- 1.3 under your usual. That's a dip, not a trend. Promise.

Training-ground special: Play in triangles - one or two touches, then move. The ball should do the running, not you.

I believe in you. More importantly, I need you to believe in you. - Coach Lasso
